D1_dynamic_critical_load_requirement.governance_rule: Dynamic P_critical(t) for fixed protected equipment defined by station policy.

D2_battery_behavior_under_option_d.governance_rule: Battery discharge permitted solely to supply dynamic critical load when generation is insufficient.

D3_zero_renewable_and_diesel_unavailable.governance_rule: Battery continues supporting protected critical systems while awaiting operator resolution.

D4_critical_load_shortfall_shedding.governance_rule: Proportionally allocate power across minimum viable levels without dynamic category priority.

D5_option_d_max_duration_and_escalation.governance_rule: Mandatory operator escalation occurs on time boundary OR resource boundary, whichever is first.

D6_diesel_minimum_excess_disposition.governance_rule: Charge battery with excess output up to allowable limit; curtail remaining excess.
